quotes.quote: I am so clever that sometimes I don't understand a single word of what I am saying.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde,  The Happy Prince and Other Stories

quotes.quote: I believe that everything happens for a reason. People change so that you can learn to let go, things go wrong so that you appreciate them when they're right, you believe lies so you eventually learn to trust no one but yourself, and sometimes good things fall apart so better things can fall together.
quotes.author: Marilyn Monroe

quotes.quote: If you judge people, you have no time to love them.
quotes.author: Mother Teresa

quotes.quote: Time you enjoy wasting is not wasted time.
quotes.author: Marthe Troly-Curtin,  Phrynette Married

quotes.quote: It's time to get real, folks. Hope and change ain't working. Hope and change is not a solution. Hope and change is not a job.
quotes.author: Herman Cain

quotes.quote: To live is so startling it leaves little time for anything else.
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.quote: What a slut time is. She screws everybody.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: Time is too slow for those who wait, too swift for those who fear, too long for those who grieve, too short for those who rejoice, but for those who love, time is eternity.
quotes.author: Henry Van Dyke

quotes.quote: I think in my case, I had no choice but to have a good sense of humor. I grew up with my dad, Danny Thomas, and George Burns and Bob Hope and Milton Berle and Sid Caesar and all those guys were at our house all the time and telling jokes and making each other laugh.
quotes.author: Marlo Thomas

quotes.quote: Success is simple. Do what's right, the right way, at the right time.
quotes.author: Arnold H. Glasow

quotes.quote: I never write anything without humor, just because I like humor, but at the same time, it is a way for anything fantastical to become relatable.
quotes.author: Joss Whedon

quotes.quote: The fear of death follows from the fear of life. A man who lives fully is prepared to die at any time.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: I hope that 'Jaws' will have brought sharks into the public interest at a time when we desperately need to reevaluate our care for the environment.
quotes.author: Peter Benchley

quotes.quote: Let your life lightly dance on the edges of Time like dew on the tip of a leaf.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.quote: I don't think just scaring people is enough. That worked during the freeze days to a major extent, but we really didn't achieve that much even at that time. You have to have more, you have to give people hope and a vision of a better world.
quotes.author: Alan Cranston

quotes.quote: I love life. There's so much to learn and see all the time, and nothing nicer for me than to wake up, and the sky is blue.
quotes.author: Pattie Boyd

quotes.quote: And in that moment, I swear we were infinite.
quotes.author: Stephen Chbosky,  The Perks of Being a Wallflower

quotes.quote: The script was just the best I'd read in a long time and I love the humor, which I wasn't expecting, and I like the fact that my six year old daughter can see the show without being, you know, protected from it.
quotes.author: Stephen Collins

quotes.quote: I'm a vegetarian and very much active in regards to how I feel about animal rights and protecting animals and giving animals a voice. But at the same time, I appreciate and respect other people's decisions to eat meat. The only thing that I hope is that people are educated, that they're aware, that they're living a conscious lifestyle.
quotes.author: Abbie Cornish

quotes.quote: Adjusting to the passage of time, I think, is a key to success and to life: just being able to roll with the punches.
quotes.author: Dolly Parton

quotes.quote: Remember, if the time should come when you have to make a choice between what is right and what is easy, remember what happened to a boy who was good, and kind, and brave, because he strayed across the path of Lord Voldemort. Remember Cedric Diggory.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

quotes.quote: Written in 1895, Alfred Nobel's will endowed prizes for scientific research in chemistry, physics, and medicine. At that time, these fields were narrowly defined, and researchers were often classically trained in only one discipline. In the late 19th century, knowledge of science was not a requisite for success in other walks of life.
quotes.author: Peter Agre

quotes.quote: I hope I may have succeeded in presenting to you, however imperfectly, the currents of thought due to the work of the immortal Darwin which have helped to make anthropology what it is at the present time.
quotes.author: Franz Boas

quotes.quote: I hope to God that the inner strength that will vindicate my deeds will in good time spring forth from my own people. I have done as I had to on the prompting of my inner voice.
quotes.author: Kurt Huber

quotes.quote: I wish it need not have happened in my time,"said Frodo."So do I,"said Gandalf, "and so do all who live to see such times. But that is not for them to decide. All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given us.
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Fellowship of the Ring

quotes.quote: In all our deeds, the proper value and respect for time determines success or failure.
quotes.author: Malcolm X

quotes.quote: In looking for humor, keep in mind this guideline: Sometimes it takes a little time to see the humor in your upsets; you may not find something to laugh about immediately.
quotes.author: Allen Klein

quotes.quote: Have regular hours for work and play; make each day both useful and pleasant, and prove that you understand the worth of time by employing it well. Then youth will be delightful, old age will bring few regrets, and life will become a beautiful success.
quotes.author: Louisa May Alcott

quotes.quote: Well, my life hasn't really changed... I've been homeschooled for a long time. So that helped a lot because of shooting and stuff. But, I have had friends who I've been friends with for years and years and they are my true friends, you know?
quotes.author: Willow Shields

quotes.quote: You can't do anything to be funny. That's cringeworthy. If your humor comes out of a place of love every time, you don't make the joke bigger than you. The funniest comedians are in touch with their emotional level.
quotes.author: John Krasinski

quotes.quote: The season of failure is the best time for sowing the seeds of success.
quotes.author: Paramahansa Yogananda

quotes.quote: It's the word 'artful'; it's such a great word, with its dark and its light side, its art and its cunning, the craft and the crafty of it - I've been preoccupied with the word 'artful' and the twin notions of 'cornucopia' and 'pickpocket' it suggests for quite some time.
quotes.author: Ali Smith

quotes.quote: When humor can be made to alternate with melancholy, one has a success, but when the same things are funny and melancholic at the same time, it's just wonderful.
quotes.author: Francois Truffaut

quotes.quote: Humor is the oxygen of children's literature. There's a lot of competition for children's time, but even kids who hate to read want to read a funny book.
quotes.author: Sid Fleischman

quotes.quote: Insult is powerful. Insult begets both rage and humor and often at the same time.
quotes.author: Suzanne Fields

quotes.quote: My dream is of a place and a time where America will once again be seen as the last best hope of earth.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: If you look back, Mozart, Haydn and Beethoven were mixing music and humor all the time.
quotes.author: Richard Hyung-ki Joo

quotes.quote: Art enables us to find ourselves and lose ourselves at the same time.
quotes.author: Thomas Merton

quotes.quote: What makes photography a strange invention is that its primary raw materials are light and time.
quotes.author: John Berger

quotes.quote: I wish I could freeze this moment, right here, right now and live in it forever.
quotes.author: Suzanne Collins,  Catching Fire

quotes.quote: I grew up in Cuba under a strong, military, oppressive dictatorship. So as a teenager, I found myself involved in a revolution. I remember during that time, a young, charismatic leader rose up, talking about hope and change. His name was Fidel Castro.
quotes.author: Rafael Cruz

quotes.quote: I'm happy to be on a winning team. My individual success, that lasts for a short period of time. The success of being a part of the South, of Atlanta, which is now the hot bed of music, that's what's gonna last the longest. The fact that I contributed to planting our flag and moving music to my city, that's what I'm most proud of.
quotes.author: T.I.

quotes.quote: Every time I've done comedy in, like, traditional comedy clubs, there's always these comedians that do really well with audiences but that the other comedians hate because they're just, you know, doing kind of cheap stuff like dancing around or doing, like, very kind of base sex humor a lot, and stuff like that.
quotes.author: Aziz Ansari

quotes.quote: I wasn't exposed to art as I was growing up, and can't recall the first time I saw a work of art. However, I remember very clearly a vision I had of a little green reindeer when I was a child, and visions emanate from the same mythical area where painting resides. Whatever the reason, I immediately felt comfortable working with visual materials.
quotes.author: William S. Burroughs

quotes.quote: Love is space and time measured by the heart.
quotes.author: Marcel Proust

quotes.quote: Sometimes you have to be apart from people you love, but that doesn't make you love them any less. Sometimes you love them more.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Last Song

quotes.quote: It's only when we truly know and understand that we have a limited time on earth - and that we have no way of knowing when our time is up, we will then begin to live each day to the fullest, as if it was the only one we had.
quotes.author: Elisabeth Kubler-Ross

quotes.quote: Someday, after mastering the winds, the waves, the tides and gravity, we shall harness for God the energies of love, and then, for a second time in the history of the world, man will have discovered fire.
quotes.author: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin

quotes.quote: People come up to me as I leave the stage after a performance and tell me tey saw my mother onstage with me every time I sing. I keep a sense of humor about it.
quotes.author: Lorna Luft

quotes.quote: Hope makes people good, a lot of the time. You hope for a brighter future, and resentment is outweighed.
quotes.author: Daisy Ridley

quotes.quote: Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood. Now is the time to understand more, so that we may fear less.
quotes.author: Marie Curie

quotes.quote: Where I am today... I still have my ups and downs, but I take it one day at a time and I just hope that I can be the best that I can possibly be, not only for myself, but also young people that are out there today that need someone to look up to.
quotes.author: Demi Lovato

quotes.quote: I'm going to do a lot of weird stuff that's not going to be like me prancing around like an insane 12-year-old. I showed everybody that side of me and I think it's time to do different stuff, even when it comes down to the type of humor. I want to do some drier, weirder stuff.
quotes.author: Andy Milonakis

quotes.quote: Every great work of art has two faces, one toward its own time and one toward the future, toward eternity.
quotes.author: Lester Bangs

quotes.quote: For the most part, comedians are pretty friendly with each other. They always say they badmouth each other, but most of the time, they're friends. We're the only ones that can really stand our type of humor.
quotes.author: Colin Quinn

quotes.quote: In order to succeed you must fail, so that you know what not to do the next time.
quotes.author: Anthony J. D'Angelo

quotes.quote: Art and nature shall always be wrestling until they eventually conquer one another so that the victory is the same stroke and line: that which is conquered, conquers at the same time.
quotes.author: Maria Sibylla Merian

quotes.quote: There is no reason why challenging themes and engaging stories have to be mutually exclusive - in fact, each can fuel the other. As a filmmaker, I want to entertain people first and foremost. If out of that comes a greater awareness and understanding of a time or a circumstance, then the hope is that change can happen.
quotes.author: Edward Zwick

quotes.quote: Summer is a great time to visit art museums, which offer the refreshing rinse of swimming pools - only instead of cool water, you immerse yourself in art.
quotes.author: Jerry Saltz

quotes.quote: It takes ten times as long to put yourself back together as it does to fall apart.
quotes.author: Suzanne Collins,  Mockingjay

quotes.quote: God lets you be successful because he trusts you that you will do the right thing with it. Now, does he get disappointed often? All the time, because people get there and they forget how they got it.
quotes.author: Steve Harvey

quotes.quote: I decided, very early on, just to accept life unconditionally; I never expected it to do anything special for me, yet I seemed to accomplish far more than I had ever hoped. Most of the time it just happened to me without my ever seeking it.
quotes.author: Audrey Hepburn

quotes.quote: The humor is essentially dark for a cartoon and sophisticated. But at the same time, being a cartoon gives the writers more freedom than in a normal sitcom. It always pushes the line that, despite human failings, the Simpsons are really decent people.
quotes.author: Dan Castellaneta

quotes.quote: The real important things are kindness and a sense of humor. I've been fortunate to have dated and could have easily married women who have those qualities, and time and circumstances didn't work out. Timing plays a big part.
quotes.author: Hill Harper

quotes.quote: Being a survivor doesn't mean being strong - it's telling people when you need a meal or a ride, company, whatever. It's paying attention to heart wisdom, feelings, not living a role, but having a unique, authentic life, having something to contribute, finding time to love and laugh. All these things are qualities of survivors.
quotes.author: Bernie Siegel

quotes.quote: Art is always and everywhere the secret confession, and at the same time the immortal movement of its time.
quotes.author: Karl Marx

quotes.quote: Cathy was the first widely syndicated humor strip created by a woman. The strip was pretty revolutionary at the time not only because it starred a female, but also because it was so emotionally honest about all the conflicting feelings many women had in 1976.
quotes.author: Cathy Guisewite

quotes.quote: I'm a big believer than a great bit is a great bit - if I go and see someone I love, like Robert Klein. I want to hear some classics and some new stuff. But a great stand-up bit takes a long time to really polish and perfect, and they're beautiful things when they're done.
quotes.author: Jerry Seinfeld

quotes.quote: Wicked people never have time for reading. It's one of the reasons for their wickedness.
quotes.author: Lemony Snicket

quotes.quote: Life is too short to not have fun; we are only here for a short time compared to the sun and the moon and all that.
quotes.author: Coolio

quotes.quote: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given us.
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Fellowship of the Ring

quotes.quote: For instance, on the planet Earth, man had always assumed that he was more intelligent than dolphins because he had achieved so much--the wheel, New York, wars and so on--whilst all the dolphins had ever done was muck about in the water having a good time. But conversely, the dolphins had always believed that they were far more intelligent than man--for precisely the same reasons.
quotes.author: Douglas Adams,  The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

quotes.quote: Youth is not a time of life; it is a state of mind; it is not a matter of rosy cheeks, red lips and supple knees; it is a matter of the will, quality of the imagination, a vigor of the emotions; it is the freshness of the deep springs of life.
quotes.author: Samuel Ullman

quotes.quote: There was a time I was very much blaming the way I felt on L.A, that it was a vacuum of creativity, of humor or anything organic, and I was really angry at the place. But then today I feel completely different - I love L.A.!
quotes.author: Naomi Watts

quotes.quote: Love doesn't just sit there, like a stone; it has to be made, like bread, remade all the time, made new.
quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin

quotes.quote: I'm not really easy to live with! There needs to be unlimited patience and unconditional love. Men I've known before loved my independent spirit and were proud of my success, to the point that they'd become jealous of the time I devote to my career.
quotes.author: Milla Jovovich

quotes.quote: Talent alone won't make you a success. Neither will being in the right place at the right time, unless you are ready. The most important question is: 'Are your ready?'
quotes.author: Johnny Carson

quotes.quote: In everyone's life, at some time, our inner fire goes out. It is then burst into flame by an encounter with another human being. We should all be thankful for those people who rekindle the inner spirit.
quotes.author: Albert Schweitzer

quotes.quote: Beauty, sweet love, is like the morning dew, Whose short refresh upon tender green, Cheers for a time, but till the sun doth show And straight is gone, as it had never been.
quotes.author: Samuel Daniel

quotes.quote: I might be in love with you."He smiles a little. "I'm waiting until I'm sure to tell you, though.
quotes.author: Veronica Roth,  Divergent

quotes.quote: Every time I do a movie like 'Finding Neverland' or 'Chocolat' or 'Shakespeare' in Love,' we deal with the creative process, but there's humor and fun along the way. I always love that kind of movie.
quotes.author: Harvey Weinstein

quotes.quote: I've learned in most areas of my life, to bounce heated choices off other people. Co-workers, my agent, my wife, a sponsor, etc. A majority of the time, that keeps me on the right side of things.
quotes.author: Kurt Sutter

quotes.quote: Ballet is an incredibly difficult, beautiful art form that takes a lot of training, a lot of time, and a lot of hard work.
quotes.author: Sutton Foster

quotes.quote: I was living an extremely burdensome life, because every time I prayed, I became more clearly aware of my faults. On the one hand, God was calling me. On the other, I was following the way of the world. Doing what God wanted made me happy; but I felt bound by the things of this world.
quotes.author: Saint Teresa of Avila

quotes.quote: I like dark humor. My favorite movie of all time is 'Harold and Maude.'
quotes.author: Leslie Mann

quotes.quote: Look, if you ask a child, 'Would you rather have a fulfilled mother or a stay-at-home Sylvia Plath,' they'll pick Sylvia Plath every time. But I think it's really important that children don't feel their parents' emotional lives depend on their success.
quotes.author: Ayelet Waldman

quotes.quote: I can't not find humor in elements of most parts of life, but at the same time nothing ever seems perpetually funny to me.
quotes.author: Greg Kinnear

quotes.quote: Life is short and we have never too much time for gladdening the hearts of those who are travelling the dark journey with us. Oh be swift to love, make haste to be kind.
quotes.author: Henri Frederic Amiel

quotes.quote: We hope that through these trade arrangements, through collaboration in training, in manpower development, and what have you, ASEAN in, say, ten years' time, will be a very different ASEAN.
quotes.author: Sellapan Ramanathan

quotes.quote: Jazz music is America's past and its potential, summed up and sanctified and accessible to anybody who learns to listen to, feel, and understand it. The music can connect us to our earlier selves and to our better selves-to-come. It can remind us of where we fit on the time line of human achievement, an ultimate value of art.
quotes.author: Wynton Marsalis

quotes.quote: Why, when we know that there's no such thing as perfect, do most of us spend an incredible amount of time and energy trying to be everything to everyone? Is it that we really admire perfection? No - the truth is that we are actually drawn to people who are real and down-to-earth. We love authenticity and we know that life is messy and imperfect.
quotes.author: Brene Brown

quotes.quote: When I teach the formal curriculum, I have the chance to think about it ahead of time. I can rehearse it. I can illustrate it with self-deprecating humor and humble-sounding personal disclosure. I can try to make it comes out just right.
quotes.author: John Ortberg

quotes.quote: There is never just one thing that leads to success for anyone. I feel it always a combination of passion, dedication, hard work, and being in the right place at the right time.
quotes.author: Lauren Conrad

quotes.quote: A man who dares to waste one hour of time has not discovered the value of life.
quotes.author: Charles Darwin

quotes.quote: In acting, there's a type of courage you're recognized for all the time. You lose 100 pounds and play a guy with AIDS, and you get rewarded. But, in life, doing what is courageous is quiet, and no one knows about it. Courage is someone making sacrifices for their family or making selfless decisions for what they hope or feel.
quotes.author: Rob Lowe

quotes.quote: I learned this, at least, by my experiment: that if one advances confidently in the direction of his dreams, and endeavors to live the life which he has imagined, he will meet with a success unexpected in common hours.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau,  Walden: Or, Life in the Woods

quotes.quote: If you love life, don't waste time, for time is what life is made up of.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: If there's a golf course in heaven, I hope it's like Augusta National. I just don't want an early tee time.
quotes.author: Gary Player

quotes.quote: Success soon palls. The joyous time is when the breeze first strikes your sails, and the waters rustle under your bows.
quotes.author: Charles Buxton

quotes.quote: If we ever hope to rid the world of the political AIDS of our time, terrorism, the rule must be clear: One does not deal with terrorists; one does not bargain with terrorists; one kills terrorists.
quotes.author: Meir Kahane

quotes.quote: Wild oats will get sown some time, and one of the arts of life is to sow them at the right time.
quotes.author: Richard Le Gallienne

quotes.quote: Life is like an onion. You peel it off one layer at a time, and sometimes you weep.
quotes.author: Carl Sandburg

quotes.quote: Finding some quiet time in your life, I think, is hugely important.
quotes.author: Mariel Hemingway

quotes.quote: By seizing the opportunities that disruption presents and leveraging hard times into greater success through outworking/outinnovating/outthinking and outworking everyone around you, this just might be the richest time of your life so far.
quotes.author: Robin S. Sharma

quotes.quote: Every parent is at some time the father of the unreturned prodigal, with nothing to do but keep his house open to hope.
quotes.author: John Ciardi

quotes.quote: Sometimes you climb out of bed in the morning and you think, I'm not going to make it, but you laugh inside -- remembering all the times you've felt that way.
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski

quotes.quote: You know, you could live a thousand lifetimes and not deserve him.
quotes.author: Suzanne Collins,  Catching Fire

quotes.quote: Any time not spent on love is wasted.
quotes.author: Torquato Tasso

quotes.quote: There comes a time in every man's life, and I've had plenty of them.
quotes.author: Casey Stengel

quotes.quote: If your goal is to make money, becoming an entrepreneur is a sucker's bet. Sure, some entrepreneurs make a lot of money, but if you calculate the amount of stress-inducing work and time it takes and multiply that by the low likelihood of success and eventual payoff, it is not a great way to get rich.
quotes.author: Eric Ries

quotes.quote: I have no time for specialized concerns, working themes or variations that lead to mastery... I like the indefinite, the boundless; I like continual uncertainty. Other qualities may be more conducive to achievement, publicity, success; but they are all outworn - as outworn as ideologies, opinions, concepts and names for things.
quotes.author: Gerhard Richter

quotes.quote: The richest love is that which submits to the arbitration of time.
quotes.author: Lawrence Durrell

quotes.quote: Didn't Lionel Richie just make a country album? No one is giving him a hard time... and God bless him - I love Lionel and should be able to do what he wants to do, like Madonna should, too. Both are having success and I applaud them. If you don't like it, don't buy it. The ageism criticism is getting old.
quotes.author: Guy Oseary

quotes.quote: I have always thought of poems as stepping stones in one's own sense of oneself. Every now and again, you write a poem that gives you self-respect and steadies your going a little bit farther out in the stream. At the same time, you have to conjure the next stepping stone because the stream, we hope, keeps flowing.
quotes.author: Seamus Heaney

quotes.quote: You said you were going for a walk!? What kind of walk takes six hours?""A long one?
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Glass

quotes.quote: I spend several days at a time without enough sleep. At first, normal activities become annoying. When you are too tired to eat, you really need some sleep. A few days later, things become strange. Loud noises become louder and more startling, familiar sounds become unfamiliar, and life reinvents itself as a surrealist dream.
quotes.author: Henry Rollins

quotes.quote: Life is all about having a good time.
quotes.author: Miley Cyrus

quotes.quote: Sometimes being a friend means mastering the art of timing. There is a time for silence. A time to let go and allow people to hurl themselves into their own destiny. And a time to prepare to pick up the pieces when it's all over.
quotes.author: Octavia Butler

quotes.quote: So once I thought of the villain with a sense of humor, I began to think of a name and the name "the Joker" immediately came to mind. There was the association with the Joker in the deck of cards, and I probably yelled literally, 'Eureka!' because I knew I had the name and the image at the same time.
quotes.author: Jerry Robinson

quotes.quote: Time is the coin of your life. It is the only coin you have, and only you can determine how it will be spent. Be careful lest you let other people spend it for you.
quotes.author: Carl Sandburg

quotes.quote: There comes a time when the world gets quiet and the only thing left is your own heart. So you'd better learn the sound of it. Otherwise you'll never understand what it's saying.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  Just Listen

quotes.quote: I don't want to wake up and be bored. That's probably my greatest fear is to have nothing to do. What better job is there than to play quarterback for an NFL team, and certainly one that I've been on for a long time and had success with? I don't plan on giving it up any time soon.
quotes.author: Tom Brady

quotes.quote: The best time to frame an answer to the letters of a friend, is the moment you receive them. Then the warmth of friendship, and the intelligence received, most forcibly cooperate.
quotes.author: William Shenstone

quotes.quote: Laughter is timeless. Imagination has no age. And dreams are forever.
quotes.author: Walt Disney Company

quotes.quote: Time flies like an arrow; fruit flies like a banana.
quotes.author: Anthony G. Oettinger

quotes.quote: I usually give a book 40 pages. If it doesn't grab me by then, adios. With young adult books, you can usually tell by Page 4 if it's worth the time. The author establishes the conflict early, sometimes in the first sentence. The themes of hope, family, friendship and overcoming hardship appeal to most everyone.
quotes.author: Regina Brett

quotes.quote: I was single for a really long time, then I realized I had abandonment issues. Then I found love online.
quotes.author: Patti Stanger

quotes.quote: Meg Ryan is a beautiful and courageous woman. I grieve the loss of her companionship but I've not lost the friendship. We talk all the time and that was what our connection was about. She has a wonderful mind and we just like a chat.
quotes.author: Russell Crowe

quotes.quote: Even though it's tiring, I'm having the time of my life.
quotes.author: Big Sean

quotes.quote: If we listened to our intellect, we'd never have a love affair. We'd never have a friendship. We'd never go into business, because we'd be cynical. Well, that's nonsense. You've got to jump off cliffs all the time and build your wings on the way down.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury

quotes.quote: In real life, it is the hare who wins. Every time. Look around you. And in any case it is my contention that Aesop was writing for the tortoise market. Hares have no time to read. They are too busy winning the game.
quotes.author: Anita Brookner

quotes.quote: I enjoy my fun time and everything like that but I love what I do.
quotes.author: Christina Milian

quotes.quote: A youth, when at home, should be filial and, abroad, respectful to his elders. He should be earnest and truthful. He should overflow in love to all and cultivate the friendship of the good. When he has time and opportunity, after the performance of these things, he should employ them in polite studies.
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.quote: Starting a band is the easy part. Once you've formed the band, you have to tell a story, and that story requires songs. And not just good songs, but great songs. After a while, great songs won't do - they have to be the best. Success doesn't make it any easier. Each time I start a new record, it's a brand-new search.
quotes.author: The Edge

quotes.quote: The loneliest moment in someone's life is when they are watching their whole world fall apart, and all they can do is stare blankly.
quotes.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald,  The Great Gatsby

quotes.quote: Next year, I hope there will be even more parties, lots of holidays and just having a good time, really. Plus wing-walking, air shows and learning to fly, as they are all things I want to do. I won't be restricted by age.
quotes.author: Carol Vorderman

quotes.quote: This is the miracle that happens every time to those who really love: the more they give, the more they possess.
quotes.author: Rainer Maria Rilke

quotes.quote: Every man regards his own life as the New Year's Eve of time.
quotes.author: Jean Paul

quotes.quote: Don't order any of the faerie food,"said Jace, looking at her over the top of his menu. "It tends to make humans a little crazy. quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Bones

quotes.quote: None of us really changes over time. We only become more fully what we are.
quotes.author: Anne Rice,  The Vampire Lestat

quotes.quote: I got introduced to Maps by my label, and I liked his sound. I had been living with the original version of 'Younger' for quite a long time when I heard the result of his remix, and I loved it. It actually made me find a new love for the track.
quotes.author: Seinabo Sey

quotes.quote: One is never ready for success. It consecrates and looses you at the same time.
quotes.author: Isabelle Adjani

quotes.quote: Each day means a new twenty-four hours. Each day means everything's possible again. You live in the moment, you die in the moment, you take it all one day at a time.
quotes.author: Marie Lu,  Legend

quotes.author: Suzanne Collins,  Mockingjay

quotes.quote: My success has been something I've worked a long time at and it's been a gradual process. I compare it to the idea of someone losing a lot of weight over a period of a few years. You don't really notice the weight loss overall but if you compare photos from then and now there's a big difference.
quotes.author: Ray William Johnson

quotes.quote: Time is the most precious element of human existence. The successful person knows how to put energy into time and how to draw success from time.
quotes.author: Denis Waitley

quotes.quote: Sometimes you make choices in life and sometimes choices make you.
quotes.author: Gayle Forman,  If I Stay

quotes.quote: For you, a thousand times over
quotes.author: Khaled Hosseini,  The Kite Runner

quotes.quote: Some things don't last forever, but some things do. Like a good song, or a good book, or a good memory you can take out and unfold in your darkest times, pressing down on the corners and peering in close, hoping you still recognize the person you see there.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  This Lullaby

quotes.quote: Today we bury his remains in the earth as a seed of immortality. Our hearts are full of sadness, yet at the same time of joyful hope and profound gratitude.
quotes.author: Pope Benedict XVI

quotes.quote: Even where friendship is concerned, it takes me a long time to trust people.
quotes.author: Namie Amuro

quotes.quote: You have to die a few times before you can reallylive.
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski,  The People Look Like Flowers at Last

quotes.quote: Music is a total constant. That's why we have such a strong visceral connection to it, you know? Because a song can take you back instantly to a moment, or a place, or even a person. No matter what else has changed in your or the world, that one song says the same, just like that moment.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  Just Listen

quotes.quote: And I would be the first to admit that probably, in a lot of press conferences over the time that I have been in coaching, indulging my own sense of humor at press conferences has not been greatly to my benefit.
quotes.author: Bobby Knight

quotes.quote: You can spend minutes, hours, days, weeks, or even months over-analyzing a situation; trying to put the pieces together, justifying what could've, would've happened... or you can just leave the pieces on the floor and move the fuck on.
quotes.author: Tupac Shakur

quotes.quote: I do think, in time, people will have, sort of, relationships with certain kinds of robots - not every robot, but certain kinds of robots - where they might feel that it is a sort of friendship, but it's going to be of a robot-human kind.
quotes.author: Cynthia Breazeal

quotes.quote: The friendship of Shostakovich cast a brilliant light over my whole life and whose spiritual qualities captured my soul once and for all time.
quotes.author: Galina Vishnevskaya

quotes.quote: Around the time I graduated from high school, I decided better to underachieve and have friendship than to overachieve and be alone.
quotes.author: Evangeline Lilly

quotes.quote: It's strange because sometimes, I read a book, and I think I am the people in the book.
quotes.author: Stephen Chbosky,  The Perks of Being a Wallflower

quotes.quote: Never can the innate power of a work be hidden or locked away. A work of art can be forgotten by time; it can be forbidden and rejected but the elemental will always prevail over the ephemeral.
quotes.author: Stefan Zweig

quotes.quote: We waste time looking for the perfect lover, instead of creating the perfect love.
quotes.author: Tom Robbins

quotes.quote: Why, sometimes I've believed as many as six impossible things before breakfast.
quotes.author: Lewis Carroll,  Alice in Wonderland

quotes.quote: Don't."Clary raised a warning hand. "I'm not really in the mood right now.""That's got to be the first time a girl's ever said that to me,"Jace mused.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Bones

quotes.quote: Death must be so beautiful. To lie in the soft brown earth, with the grasses waving above one's head, and listen to silence. To have no yesterday, and no tomorrow. To forget time, to forgive life, to be at peace.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde,  The Canterville Ghost

quotes.quote: You know,"Gabriel said, "there was a time I thought we could be friends, Will.""There was a time I thought I was a ferret,"Will said, "but that turned out to be the opium haze. Did you know it had that effect? Because I didn't.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Angel

quotes.quote: Francois Rabelais. He was a poet. And his last words were "I go to seek a Great Perhaps."That's why I'm going. So I don't have to wait until I die to start seeking a Great Perhaps.
quotes.author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

quotes.quote: Even a purely moral act that has no hope of any immediate and visible political effect can gradually and indirectly, over time, gain in political significance.
quotes.author: Vaclav Havel

quotes.quote: This moment will just be another story someday.

quotes.quote: If it is your time, love will track you down like a cruise missile.
quotes.author: Lynda Barry

quotes.quote: Sixth grade was a big time, in my childhood, of hoops and friendship, and coming up with funny things.
quotes.author: Adam Sandler

quotes.quote: She wasn't bitter. She was sad, though. But it was a hopeful kind of sad. The kind of sad that just takes time.
quotes.author: Stephen Chbosky,  The Perks of Being a Wallflower

quotes.quote: Everywhere is within walking distance if you have the time.
quotes.author: Steven Wright

quotes.quote: When it comes to partnership, some humans can make their lives alone - it's possible. But creatively, it's more like painting: you can't just use the same colours in every painting. quotes.author: Ben Harper

quotes.quote: Sometimes it seems safer to hold it all in, where the only person who can judge is yourself.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen

quotes.quote: We all have our time machines, don't we. Those that take us back are memories...And those that carry us forward, are dreams.
quotes.author: H.G. Wells

quotes.quote: The bracelet says 'Fear Nothing.' It was given to me by my friends, and it was made for me and my friends during the period of time that I was going through chemotherapy. quotes.author: Joseph J. Lhota

quotes.quote: I was born in 1949, and by the time I was 10, I figured out that my hope chest was not aimed in the same direction everybody else's was. And that life was going to be very, very complicated. And that I could either be provocative and declamatory, or shy, retiring and scared.
quotes.author: Dorothy Allison

quotes.quote: All endings are also beginnings. We just don't know it at the time.
quotes.author: Mitch Albom,  The Five People You Meet In Heaven

quotes.quote: Marriage is the highest state of friendship. If happy, it lessens our cares by dividing them, at the same time that it doubles our pleasures by mutual participation.
quotes.author: Samuel Richardson

quotes.quote: People, I have discovered, are layers and layers of secrets. You believe you know them, that you understand them, but their motives are always hidden from you, buried in their own hearts. You will never know them, but sometimes you decide to trust them.
quotes.author: Veronica Roth,  Insurgent

quotes.quote: Is standing by the window muttering about blood something he does all the time?"asked Simon."No,"Jace said. "Sometimes he sits on the couch and does it.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Ashes

quotes.quote: I cherish the memory of being a friend of Frank Sinatra on a friendship level to the point where we really hung out. quotes.author: Frankie Valli

quotes.quote: To cement a new friendship, especially between foreigners or persons of a different social world, a spark with which both were secretly charged must fly from person to person, and cut across the accidents of place and time.
quotes.author: Cornelia Otis Skinner

quotes.quote: Humor is very interesting to me. My films are not comedies, but there's comedy in them from time to time, absurdities, just like in real life.
quotes.author: David Lynch

quotes.quote: Sometimes people don't want to hear the truth because they don't want their illusions destroyed.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: I suspect the truth is that we are waiting, all of us, against insurmountable odds, for something extraordinary to happen to us.
quotes.author: Khaled Hosseini,  And the Mountains Echoed

quotes.author: Sammy Sosa

quotes.quote: Books have a unique way of stopping time in a particular moment and saying: Let's not forget this.
quotes.author: Dave Eggers

quotes.quote: All the world's a stage, And all the men and women merely players; They have their exits and their entrances; And one man in his time plays many parts, His acts being seven ages.

quotes.quote: Education is an admirable thing, but it is well to remember from time to time that nothing that is worth knowing can be taught.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: If we wait for the moment when everything, absolutely everything is ready, we shall never begin.
quotes.author: Ivan Turgenev

quotes.quote: There's plenty of sense in nonsense sometimes, if you wish to look for it.

quotes.quote: If I didn't try to eavesdrop on every bus ride I take or look for the humor when I go for a walk, I would just be depressed all the time.

quotes.author: Raekwon

quotes.author: Mary Oliver

quotes.author: Lauren Oliver,  Before I Fall

quotes.quote: It is true that those we meet can change us, sometimes so profoundly that we are not the same afterwards, even unto our names.
quotes.author: Yann Martel,  Life of Pi

quotes.author: Danielle Harris

quotes.quote: Don't wait for a light to appear at the end of the tunnel, stride down there and light the bloody thing yourself.
quotes.author: Sara Henderson

quotes.quote: It's possible to go on, no matter how impossible it seems, and that in time, the grief . . . lessens. It may not go away completely, but after a while it's not so overwhelming.

quotes.quote: For last year's words belong to last year's language And next year's words await another voice.

quotes.author: Daniel J. Goor

quotes.author: Jean Cocteau

quotes.author: Tammy Faye Bakker

quotes.author: Jamie McGuire,  Beautiful Disaster

quotes.quote: We both have war inside us. Sometimes it keeps us alive. Sometimes it threatens to destroy us.
quotes.author: Veronica Roth,  Insurgent

quotes.author: Danica Patrick

quotes.quote: You can never control who you fall in love with, even when you're in the most sad, confused time of your life. You don't fall in love with people because they're fun. It just happens.

quotes.author: A.A. Milne

quotes.quote: How did it get so late so soon?
quotes.author: Dr. Seuss

quotes.author: Terry Pratchett

quotes.author: Robert Jordan

quotes.quote: Every time you smile at someone, it is an action of love, a gift to that person, a beautiful thing.
quotes.author: Mother Teresa

quotes.author: J. D. Salinger

quotes.quote: Time is the coin of your life. You spend it. Do not allow others to spend it for you.
quotes.author: Carl Sandburg

quotes.author: Jennifer Jason Leigh

quotes.quote: Every time you are tempted to react in the same old way, ask if you want to be a prisoner of the past or a pioneer of the future.
quotes.author: Deepak Chopra

quotes.author: Anne Lamott

quotes.quote: I like to see people reunited, I like to see people run to each other, I like the kissing and the crying, I like the impatience, the stories that the mouth can't tell fast enough, the ears that aren't big enough, the eyes that can't take in all of the change, I like the hugging, the bringing together, the end of missing someone.
quotes.author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close

quotes.quote: I was close to getting married a long time ago. But it didn't happen, and since then it has not been happening. It is jinxed, and I am very happy. I hope this jinx continues.
quotes.author: Salman Khan

quotes.quote: Even the strongest and bravest must sometimes weep. It shows they have a great heart, one that can feel compassion for others.
quotes.author: Brian Jacques,  Redwall

quotes.quote: No distance of place or lapse of time can lessen the friendship of those who are thoroughly persuaded of each other's worth.
quotes.author: Robert Southey

quotes.quote: When I talk to people in need, they tell me they want to hope; they are eager for opportunity; they are ready for better days. And I can tell you that every time their hopes are disappointed, all nations lose.
quotes.author: Abdallah II of Jordan

quotes.author: Max von Sydow

quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: Yesterday is gone. Tomorrow has not yet come. We have only today. Let us begin.

quotes.quote: I think humor is used a lot of the time to keep people from getting too close. Humor side-steps and shifts the meaning.
quotes.author: Bruce Nauman

quotes.quote: Morning is wonderful. Its only drawback is that it comes at such an inconvenient time of day.
quotes.author: Glen Cook,  Sweet Silver Blues

quotes.quote: Open a book this minute and start reading. Don't move until you've reached page fifty. Until you've buried your thoughts in print. Cover yourself with words. Wash yourself away. Dissolve.
quotes.author: Carol Shields,  The Republic of Love

quotes.author: Harry Knowles

quotes.quote: It must require bravery to be honest all the time.

quotes.quote: You can have it all. Just not all at once.
quotes.author: Oprah Winfrey

quotes.quote: Sometimes you read a book so special that you want to carry it around with you for months after you've finished just to stay near it.
quotes.author: Markus Zusak

quotes.quote: And I guess I realized at that moment that I really did love her. Because there was nothing to gain, and that didn't matter.
quotes.author: Stephen Chbosky,  The Perks of Being a Wallflower

quotes.quote: Sometimes, I feel the past and the future pressing so hard on either side that there's no room for the present at all.
quotes.author: Evelyn Waugh,  Brideshead Revisited

quotes.quote: Travel is fatal to prejudice, bigotry, and narrow-mindedness, and many of our people need it sorely on these accounts. Broad, wholesome, charitable views of men and things cannot be acquired by vegetating in one little corner of the earth all one's lifetime.
quotes.author: Mark Twain,  The Innocents Abroad/Roughing It

quotes.quote: Death is a challenge. It tells us not to waste time... It tells us to tell each other right now that we love each other.
quotes.author: Leo Buscaglia

quotes.quote: I think faith helps me a lot. God wants you to be where He wants you to be, and that's where I want to be. My faith is also where my core friends are, at my church, a faith-based friendship.
quotes.author: Jason Dolley

quotes.quote: You do have a story inside you; it lies articulate and waiting to be written -- behind your silence and your suffering.
quotes.author: Anne Rice

quotes.quote: Sometimes things fall apart so that better things can fall together
quotes.author: Marilyn Monroe

quotes.quote: But who can say what's best? That's why you need to grab whatever chance you have of happiness where you find it, and not worry about other people too much. quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  Norwegian Wood

quotes.quote: If you love what you do and are willing to do what it takes, it's within your reach. And it'll be worth every minute you spend alone at night, thinking and thinking about what it is you want to design or build. It'll be worth it, I promise.
quotes.author: Steve Wozniak

quotes.quote: I don't know if One Direction will stand the test of time. I have a niece who goes crazy for them. But the only way to judge art is to wait and see if it becomes evergreen. This takes a bit of time. Adele is a very good musician and I'd like to sing with her. But, again, time will tell if her music will become evergreen.
quotes.author: Andrea Bocelli

quotes.quote: I experience for the American officers and soldiers that friendship which arises from having shared with them for a length of time dangers, sufferings, and both good and evil fortune.
quotes.author: Marquis de Lafayette

quotes.quote: being alone never felt right. sometimes it felt good, but it never felt right.
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski,  Women

quotes.quote: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life. Don't be trapped by dogma - which is living with the results of other people's thinking. quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.quote: Madness is the absolute break with the work of art; it forms the constitutive moment of abolition, which dissolves in time the truth of the work of art.
quotes.author: Michel Foucault

quotes.quote: I firmly believe, only because I've been doing this for so long, every show takes three years. 90% of them don't get three years. It just does. It takes a long time to build a community, build a friendship with your characters. It's hard for people to grasp on and make them care about you.
quotes.author: Kaley Cuoco

quotes.quote: They say I'm old-fashioned, and live in the past, but sometimes I think progress progresses too fast!
quotes.author: Dr. Seuss

quotes.quote: There was a time when I thought dudes had friendship all figured out. quotes.author: Lynn Coady

quotes.quote: It is one of life's bitterest truths that bedtime so often arrives just when things are really getting interesting.
quotes.author: Lemony Snicket,  The Grim Grotto

quotes.quote: Once upon a time, an angel and a devil fell in love. It did not end well.

quotes.quote: I'm always happy,"Sasha said. "Sometimes I just forget.
quotes.author: Jennifer Egan,  A Visit from the Goon Squad

quotes.quote: Time is the longest distance between two places.
quotes.author: Tennessee Williams,  The Glass Menagerie

quotes.quote: Don't spend time beating on a wall, hoping to transform it into a door.
quotes.author: Coco Chanel

quotes.quote: I think people just like seeing friendship. I think people like seeing people who just drive each other up the wall, but at same time, can't live without each other.
quotes.author: Martin Freeman

quotes.quote: The ultimate measure of a man is not where he stands in moments of comfort and convenience, but where he stands at times of challenge and controversy.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King Jr.

quotes.quote: It's like everyone tells a story about themselves inside their own head. Always. All the time. That story makes you what you are. We build ourselves out of that story.
quotes.author: Patrick Rothfuss,  The Name of the Wind

quotes.quote: History does not always repeat itself. Sometimes it just yells, 'Can't you remember anything I told you?' and lets fly with a club.
quotes.author: John W. Campbell Jr.

quotes.quote: The two most important requirements for major success are: first, being in the right place at the right time, and second, doing something about it.
quotes.author: Ray Kroc

quotes.quote: If neurotic is wanting two mutually exclusive things at one and the same time, then I'm neurotic as hell. I'll be flying back and forth between one mutually exclusive thing and another for the rest of my days.

quotes.quote: so I wait for you like a lonely housetill you will see me again and live in me.Till then my windows ache.
