quotes.quote: Everyone who achieves success in a great venture, solves each problem as they came to it. They helped themselves. And they were helped through powers known and unknown to them at the time they set out on their voyage. They keep going regardless of the obstacles they met.
quotes.author: W. Clement Stone

quotes.quote: I myself have never been able to find out precisely what feminism is: I only know that people call me a feminist whenever I express sentiments that differentiate me from a doormat.
quotes.author: Rebecca West

quotes.quote: They always say time changes things, but you actually have to change them yourself.
quotes.author: Andy Warhol,  The Philosophy of Andy Warhol

quotes.quote: The future is now. It's time to grow up and be strong. Tomorrow may well be too late.
quotes.author: Neil LaBute,  Reasons to Be Pretty

quotes.quote: Don't waste your time with explanations: people only hear what they want to hear.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho

quotes.quote: We dream in our waking moments, and walk in our sleep.
quotes.author: Nathaniel Hawthorne,  The Scarlet Letter

quotes.quote: If you can get humor and seriousness at the same time, you've created a special little thing, and that's what I'm looking for, because if you get pompous, you lose everything.
quotes.author: Paul Simon

quotes.quote: This is a new year. A new beginning. And things will change.
quotes.author: Taylor Swift

quotes.quote: Have you ever lost someone you love and wanted one more conversation, one more chance to make up for the time when you thought they would be here forever? If so, then you know you can go your whole life collecting days, and none will outweigh the one you wish you had back.
quotes.author: Mitch Albom,  For One More Day

quotes.quote: Stuff your eyes with wonder, he said, live as if you'd drop dead in ten seconds. See the world. It's more fantastic than any dream made or paid for in factories.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury,  Fahrenheit 451

quotes.quote: Where you used to be, there is a hole in the world, which I find myself constantly walking around in the daytime, and falling in at night. I miss you like hell.
quotes.author: Edna St. Vincent Millay

quotes.quote: It is very risky. But each time a child opens a book, he pushes open the gate that separates him from Elsewhere.
quotes.author: Lois Lowry

quotes.quote: For many people, myself included, the end of the world is happening all the time! It is a form of criticality that paradoxically gives us hope for change and improvement.
quotes.author: Douglas Coupland

quotes.quote: Sometimes, the best way to help someone is just to be near them.
quotes.author: Veronica Roth,  Divergent

quotes.quote: I pray because I can't help myself. I pray because I'm helpless. I pray because the need flows out of me all the time- waking and sleeping. It doesn't change God- it changes me.
quotes.author: William Nicholson,  Shadowlands

quotes.quote: I'm afraid that sometimes you'll play lonely games too. Games you can't win 'cause you'll play against you.
quotes.author: Dr. Seuss

quotes.quote: Sometimes you lose a battle. But mischief always wins the war
quotes.author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

quotes.quote: I don't suffer from my insanity -- I enjoy every minute of it.
quotes.author: Sherrilyn Kenyon,  Dance with the Devil

quotes.quote: While I sleep, I dream of you, and when I wake, I long to hold you in my arms. If anything, our time apart has only made me more certain that I want to spend my nights by your side, and my days with your heart.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  Nights in Rodanthe

quotes.quote: Second star to the right and straight on 'til morning.
quotes.author: J.M. Barrie,  Peter Pan

quotes.quote: In times of grief and sorrow I will hold you and rock you and take your grief and make it my own. When you cry I cry and when you hurt I hurt. And together we will try to hold back the floods to tears and despair and make it through the potholed street of life
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Notebook

quotes.quote: It is the time you have wasted for your rose that makes your rose so important.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-ExupÃ©ry,  The Little Prince

quotes.quote: One must live as if it would be forever, and as if one might die each moment. Always both at once.
quotes.author: Mary Renault,  The Persian Boy

quotes.quote: One more time? For the audience?"he says. His voice isn't angry. It's hollow, which is worse. Already the boy with the bread is slipping away from me.I take his hand, holding on tightly, preparing for the cameras, and dreading the moment when I will finally have to let go.
quotes.author: Suzanne Collins,  The Hunger Games

quotes.quote: Light thinks it travels faster than anything but it is wrong. No matter how fast light travels, it finds the darkness has always got there first, and is waiting for it.
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett,  Reaper Man

quotes.quote: Look at everything always as though you were seeing it either for the first or last time: Thus is your time on earth filled with glory.
quotes.author: Betty Smith,  A Tree Grows in Brooklyn

quotes.quote: There's nothing worse than waiting and not knowing what'll happen to you. Your own imagination can be crueler than any captor.
quotes.author: Richelle Mead,  Frostbite

quotes.quote: If there's one thing I've learned, it's this: We all want everything to be okay. We don't even wish so much for fantastic or marvelous or outstanding. We will happily settle for okay, because most of the time, okay is enough.
quotes.author: David Levithan,  Every Day

quotes.quote: Sometimes, when I have to do something I don't want to do, I pretend I'm a character from a book. It's easier to know what they would do.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Angel

quotes.quote: Whenever you think or you believe or you know, you're a lot of other people: but the moment you feel, you're nobody-but-yourself.
quotes.author: E.E. Cummings

quotes.quote: It's so strange how life works: You want something and you wait and wait and feel like it's taking forever to come. Then it happens and it's over and all you want to do is curl back up in that moment before things changed.
quotes.author: Lauren Oliver,  Delirium

quotes.quote: Child, child, do you not see? For each of us comes a time when we must be more than what we are.
quotes.author: Lloyd Alexander,  The Black Cauldron

quotes.quote: You can't tell mewhat to do anymore, Travis! I don't belong to you!'In the second it took him to turn and face me, hisexpression had contorted into anger. He stomped towardme, planting his hands on the bed and leaning into my face.'WELL I BELONG TO YOU!' The veins in his neckbulged as he shouted, and I met his glare, refusing to evenflinch. He looked at my lips, panting. 'I belong to you.
quotes.author: Jamie McGuire,  Beautiful Disaster

quotes.quote: You're beautiful and sad,"I said finally, not looking at him when I did. "Just like your eyes. You're like a song that I heard when I was a little kid but forgot I knew until I heard it again."For a long moment there was only the whirring sound of the tires on the road, and then Sam said softly, "Thank you.
quotes.author: Maggie Stiefvater,  Shiver

quotes.quote: Is there some particular reason that you're here?"..."Not this again.""Not what again?"said Clary."Every time I annoy him, he retreats into his No Mundanes Allowed tree house."Simon pointed at Jace.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Ashes

quotes.quote: Time extracts various values from a painter's work. When these values are exhausted the pictures are forgotten, and the more a picture has to give, the greater it is.
quotes.author: Henri Matisse

quotes.quote: It is always sad when someone leaves home, unless they are simply going around the corner and will return in a few minutes with ice-cream sandwiches.
quotes.author: Lemony Snicket,  Horseradish

quotes.quote: I'm glad we had the times together just to laugh and sing a song, seems like we just got started and then before you know it, the times we had together were gone.
quotes.author: Dr. Seuss

quotes.quote: I want everyone to meet you. You're my favorite person of all time.
quotes.author: Rainbow Rowell,  Eleanor & Park

quotes.quote: The secret of a happy marriage is finding the right person. You know they're right if you love to be with them all the time.
quotes.author: Julia Child

quotes.quote: Even in the Future the Story Begins with Once Upon a Time.
quotes.author: Marissa Meyer,  Cinder

quotes.quote: She was ready to deny the existence of space and time rather than admit that love might not be eternal.
quotes.author: Simone de Beauvoir,  The Mandarins

quotes.quote: I think it's good for a person to spend time alone. It gives them an opportunity to discover who they are and to figure out why they are always alone.
quotes.author: Amy Sedaris,  I Like You: Hospitality Under the Influence

quotes.quote: I used to make up stuff in my bio all the time, that I used to be a professional ice-skater and stuff like that. I found it so inspirational. Why not make myself cooler than I am?
quotes.author: Stephen Colbert

quotes.quote: For a long time, music was hope. Now it seems music isn't enough to make me happy. It used to be that's all I needed to keep going. Now I need other things to take up the other parts of my life.
quotes.author: Juliana Hatfield

quotes.quote: That's the thing about girls. Every time they do something pretty, even if they're not much to look at, or even if they're sort of stupid, you fall in love with them, and then you never know where the hell you are. Girls. Jesus Christ. They can drive you crazy. They really can.
quotes.author: J.D. Salinger,  The Catcher in the Rye

quotes.quote: Time to leave now, get out of this room, go somewhere, anywhere; sharpen this feeling of happiness and freedom, stretch your limbs, fill your eyes, be awake, wider awake, vividly awake in every sense and every pore.
quotes.author: Stefan Zweig,  The Post-Office Girl

quotes.quote: All this time I've hated myself for it. I thought I'd given it up for nothing. But if I hadn't fallen, I wouldn't have met you.
quotes.author: Becca Fitzpatrick,  Hush, Hush

quotes.quote: Tonight's December thirty-first,Something is about to burst.The clock is crouching, dark and small,Like a time bomb in the hall.Hark, it's midnight, children dear.Duck! Here comes another year!
quotes.author: Ogden Nash,  Collected verse from 1929 on

quotes.quote: Sometimes I don't get you,' I said. She didn't even glance at me. She just smiled toward the television and said, 'You never get me. That's the whole point.
quotes.author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

quotes.quote: Never attempt to teach a pig to sing; it wastes your time and annoys the pig.
quotes.author: Robert A. Heinlein,  Time Enough for Love

quotes.quote: There comes a time in every life when the world gets quiet and the only thing left is your heart.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  Just Listen

quotes.quote: Winter is the time for comfort, for good food and warmth, for the touch of a friendly hand and for a talk beside the fire: it is the time for home.
quotes.author: Edith Sitwell

quotes.quote: When we hold each other, in the darkness, it doesn't make the darkness go away. The bad things are still out there. The nightmares still walking. When we hold each other we feel not safe, but better. "It's all right"we whisper, "I'm here, I love you."and we lie: "I'll never leave you."For just a moment or two the darkness doesn't seem so bad.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  Neil Gaiman's Midnight Days

quotes.quote: The moon is a loyal companion.It never leaves. It's always there, watching, steadfast, knowing us in our light and dark moments, changing forever just as we do. Every day it's a different version of itself. Sometimes weak and wan, sometimes strong and full of light. The moon understands what it means to be human.Uncertain. Alone. Cratered by imperfections.
quotes.author: Tahereh Mafi,  Shatter Me

quotes.quote: I do have a lot of time for people in my life, and friendship is a very important subject for me. I think I'm unusual among the writers I know in that respect.
quotes.author: Salman Rushdie

quotes.quote: I discovered that in a story I could safely dream any dream, hope any hope, go anywhere I pleased any time I pleased, fight any foe, win or lose, live or die. My stories created a safe experimental learning place.
quotes.author: Donald Davis

quotes.quote: A question that sometimes drives me hazy: am I or are the others crazy?
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: I can write the saddest poem of all tonight. I loved her, and sometimes she loved me too.
quotes.author: Pablo Neruda

quotes.quote: I came to Venice for the first time in 1968 and was lucky enough to make the acquaintanceship, and then the friendship, of two Venetians, Roberta and Franco, who remain my best friends here after almost 50 years.
quotes.author: Donna Leon

quotes.quote: It's high time for the art world to admit that the avant-garde is dead. It was killed by my hero, Andy Warhol, who incorporated into his art all the gaudy commercial imagery of capitalism (like Campbell's soup cans) that most artists had stubbornly scorned.
quotes.author: Camille Paglia

quotes.quote: I think if there's something one needs to change with oneself, it doesn't have to happen in the New Year. You can do that any time you please - not that it's not a good inspirational tactic for the people that it works for.
quotes.author: Brittany Murphy

quotes.quote: Our dilemma is that we hate change and love it at the same time; what we really want is for things to remain the same but get better.
quotes.author: Sydney J. Harris

quotes.quote: We can't understand when we're pregnant, or when our siblings are expecting, how profound it is to have a shared history with a younger generation: blood, genes, humor. It means we were actually here, on Earth, for a time - like the Egyptians with their pyramids, only with children.
quotes.author: Anne Lamott

quotes.quote: My childhood, adolescence and high school days are unusually important. If there has ever been a time that I developed a uniqueness and sense of humor and the ability to organize, it was then. In those early days, I developed the skills that gave me a certain degree of success in American politics.
quotes.author: Lee Atwater

quotes.quote: I will never forget experiencing Venice for the first time. It feels like you are transported to another time - the art, music, food and pure romance in the air is like no other place.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Berkley

quotes.quote: People come in and out of our lives, and the true test of friendship is whether you can pick back up right where you left off the last time you saw each other.
quotes.author: Lisa See

quotes.quote: Logic is one thing, the human animal another. You can quite easily propose a logical solution to something and at the same time hope in your heart of hearts it won't work out.
quotes.author: Luigi Pirandello

quotes.quote: Faith is salted and peppered through everything at Christmas. And I love at least one night by the Christmas tree to sing and feel the quiet holiness of that time that's set apart to celebrate love, friendship, and God's gift of the Christ child.
quotes.author: Amy Grant

quotes.quote: I try not to put anything political on the forefront of what I'm trying to do creatively. At the same time, I do think it's wonderful when I hear people say that it's inspirational that I'm an Indian woman on camera. My life is very diverse, and my friends are a diverse group of people.
quotes.author: Mindy Kaling

quotes.quote: If you're playing a good guy, you show some darkness. If you're playing a dark guy, you show something different, like humor, that will mix it up and hopefully surpass the audience's expectations. What I'm battling all the time is complacency in the audience. I try to bring a little mystery to what might happen because that engages people more.
quotes.author: Campbell Scott

quotes.quote: When everything happens to you when you're so young, you're very lucky, but by the same token, you're never going to have that same feeling again. The first time anything happens to you - your first love, your first success - the second one is never the same.
quotes.author: Lauren Bacall

quotes.quote: Children should be able to live a life free from bullying and harassment and it is time that we all took a stand against this.
quotes.author: Katherine Jenkins

quotes.quote: I have a 6-year-old niece who doesn't look like the majority of girls on the covers of magazines. I hope that by the time she's 16, the world will have changed.
quotes.author: Prabal Gurung

quotes.quote: The single most important thing in a child's performance is the quality of the teacher. Making sure a child spends the maximum amount of time with inspirational teachers is the most important thing.
quotes.author: Michael Gove

quotes.quote: It's hard being left behind. (...) It's hard to be the one who stays.
quotes.author: Audrey Niffenegger,  The Time Traveler's Wife

quotes.quote: After a point of time, when you get success and fame, money and everything, the purpose of life has to be redefined. For me, I think that purpose is to build bridges. Artists can do that very easily, more than politicians.
quotes.author: A. R. Rahman

quotes.quote: When you go on your Twitter or look down your Timeline and it's all great positivity - I love that. But at the same time, it can really divert you from what your purpose is or what you're trying to do. And I've seen artists get caught up in that.
quotes.author: Kendrick Lamar

quotes.quote: In sports teams, apart from talk of sporting prowess and the imparting of inspirational thought, an extraordinary amount of time is spent discussing, and flaunting, material possessions.
quotes.author: Harsha Bhogle

quotes.quote: It's as if inside the White House the belief in Obama's inspirational charisma is still such that every time the ugliness of brute politics intrudes, it's a startling revelation.
quotes.author: Tina Brown

quotes.quote: I decided at 40 I was wasting entire chunks of my brain and didn't want to blow my one chance on Earth. I'm glad I made that decision. Writing is largely about time, while visual art is largely about space. Sometimes, as with film, you can hybridize, but I think it's basically the space part of my brain wanting equal footing with the time part.
quotes.author: Douglas Coupland

quotes.quote: There's so much to appreciate about my life every single day, and I make a big point of taking time to smell the roses and noticing how lucky I am. I never want to take that for granted.
quotes.author: Josie Maran

quotes.quote: Time makes friendship stronger, but love weaker.
quotes.author: Jean de la Bruyere

quotes.quote: It's dark now and I am very tired. I love you, always. Time is nothing.
quotes.author: Audrey Niffenegger,  The Time Traveler's Wife

quotes.quote: My art is an attempt to reach beyond the surface appearance. I want to see growth in wood, time in stone, nature in a city, and I do not mean its parks but a deeper understanding that a city is nature too-the ground upon which it is built, the stone with which it is made.
quotes.author: Andy Goldsworthy

quotes.quote: I was born in the '60s and grew up in the '70s - not exactly the best decade for food in British history. It was horrendous. It was a time when, as a nation, we excelled in art and music and acting and photography and fashion - all creative skills... all apart from cooking.
quotes.author: Heston Blumenthal

quotes.quote: It will give them the opportunity to show themselves worthy of the respect and friendship of peace-loving nations, and in time, to take an honorable place among members of the United Nations.
quotes.author: James F. Byrnes

quotes.quote: Time is a game played beautifully by children.
quotes.author: Heraclitus,  Fragments

quotes.quote: One day spent with someone you love can change everything.
quotes.author: Mitch Albom,  For One More Day

quotes.quote: Winning is great, sure, but if you are really going to do something in life, the secret is learning how to lose. Nobody goes undefeated all the time. If you can pick up after a crushing defeat, and go on to win again, you are going to be a champion someday.
quotes.author: Wilma Rudolph

quotes.quote: We are at our very best, and we are happiest, when we are fully engaged in work we enjoy on the journey toward the goal we've established for ourselves. It gives meaning to our time off and comfort to our sleep. It makes everything else in life so wonderful, so worthwhile.
quotes.author: Earl Nightingale

quotes.quote: We get to live in a time that we get to use social media as a tool. It's not just a face on a piece of paper, and that's what makes you someone's favorite model. We can have a very similar sense of humor as someone, and that's why we're their favorite model, or our personal style, off the runway, is why we're their favorite.
quotes.author: Gigi Hadid

quotes.quote: It is by no means an irrational fancy that, in a future existence, we shall look upon what we think our present existence, as a dream.
quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe

quotes.quote: My favorite things in life don't cost any money. It's really clear that the most precious resource we all have is time.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.quote: I visited Jobs for the last time in his Palo Alto, Calif., home. He had moved to a downstairs bedroom because he was too weak to go up and down stairs. He was curled up in some pain, but his mind was still sharp and his humor vibrant.
quotes.author: Walter Isaacson

quotes.quote: Our time here is magic! It's the only space you have to realize whatever it is that is beautiful, whatever is true, whatever is great, whatever is potential, whatever is rare, whatever is unique, in. It's the only space.
quotes.author: Ben Okri

quotes.quote: As people are walking all the time, in the same spot, a path appears.
quotes.author: John Locke

quotes.quote: I have no faith in human perfectibility. I think that human exertion will have no appreciable effect upon humanity. Man is now only more active - not more happy - nor more wise, than he was 6000 years ago.
quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe

quotes.quote: When you are missing someone, time seems to move slower, and when I'm falling in love with someone, time seems to be moving faster.
quotes.author: Taylor Swift

quotes.quote: Being with you and not being with you is the only way I have to measure time.
quotes.author: Jorge Luis Borges

quotes.quote: Time takes it all, whether you want it to or not.
quotes.author: Stephen King,  The Green Mile

quotes.quote: I'm the one that has to die when it's time for me to die, so let me live my life, the way I want to.
quotes.author: Jimi Hendrix

quotes.quote: She is free in her wildness, she is a wanderess, a drop of free water. She knows nothing of borders and cares nothing for rules or customs. 'Time' for her isn't something to fight against. Her life flows clean, with passion, like fresh water.
quotes.author: Roman Payne

quotes.quote: The future is something which everyone reaches at the rate of sixty minutes an hour, whatever he does, whoever he is.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: When you get into a tight place and everything goes against you, till it seems as though you could not hang on a minute longer, never give up then, for that is just the place and time that the tide will turn.
quotes.author: Harriet Beecher Stowe

quotes.quote: Most people are enduring a marginalized isolation. One of the great obstacles to modern friendships is the 'religion of rush.' People are rushing all the time through time. Friendship takes time.
quotes.author: John O'Donohue

quotes.quote: Someone is sitting in the shade today because someone planted a tree a long time ago.
quotes.author: Warren Buffett

quotes.quote: I don't understand people who say they need more "Me Time."What other time is there? Do these people spend part of their day in someone else's body?
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Spend enough time around success and failure, and you learn a reverence for possibility.
quotes.author: Dale Dauten

quotes.quote: I don't think I'm romantic at all. I have a lot of faith in the right thing happening. I don't really hope for a lot of particulars, I just have faith that the right thing will happen most of the time.
quotes.author: Juliana Hatfield

quotes.quote: If you only had 48 hours left to live, would you spend it like you normally spend your weekends? If not, why spend 2/7th of your life wasting your free time? After all, free time isn't free. Free time is the most expensive time you have, because nobody pays for it but you. But that also makes it the most valuable time you have, as you alone stand to reap the profits from spending it wisely.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  I Should Have Renamed This

quotes.quote: True generosity is an offering; given freely and out of pure love. No strings attached. No expectations. Time and love are the most valuable possession you can share.
quotes.author: Suze Orman

quotes.quote: Start-up success is not a consequence of good genes or being in the right place at the right time. Success can be engineered by following the right process, which means it can be learned, which means it can be taught.
quotes.author: Eric Ries

quotes.quote: I like to think my sense of humor is sort of smart and dumb at the same time. I like to work on multiple levels - smart and dumb, funny and sad, profound and mundane, cynical and hopeful.
quotes.author: Robert Lopez

quotes.quote: Meditation is to dive all the way within, beyond thought, to the source of thought and pure consciousness. It enlarges the container, every time you transcend. When you come out, you come out refreshed, filled with energy and enthusiasm for life.
quotes.author: David Lynch

quotes.quote: Spring passes and one remembers one's innocence.Summer passes and one remembers one's exuberance.Autumn passes and one remembers one's reverence.Winter passes and one remembers one's perseverance.
quotes.author: Yoko Ono

quotes.quote: There are memories that time does not erase... Forever does not make loss forgettable, only bearable.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Heavenly Fire

quotes.quote: As if you could kill time without injuring eternity.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau,  Walden

quotes.quote: The difficulty of IVF or of any fertility issues is the hope and the shattered hope, the dream that it might happen this time and then it doesn't happen.
quotes.author: Brooke Shields

quotes.quote: There is more to life than simply increasing its speed.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: I like to be lazy. I do like to be busy and really active, but when that's done, you can be sure I will be a lazy boy. I like to take time and relax and enjoy life.
quotes.author: Olivier Theyskens

quotes.quote: I'm not a very good sleeper. But you know what? I'm willing to put in a few extra hours every day to get better. That's just the kind of hard worker I am.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Whenever You're Gone, I'm Here For You

quotes.quote: When anybody honks at me in traffic, I blush, wave, and shout, 'Thanks for being a fan.' Being a celebrity is a 24/7 thing.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  $3.33

quotes.quote: It's sad when you can't make everyone happy, though. It's impossible but, at the same time, you still hope. You think, 'Maybe I can do it,' but you know you can't. But gosh, if I had to rely on giving people what they wanted, I would have had to write 40 billion different books and even then, I wouldn't get it right.
quotes.author: Stephenie Meyer

quotes.quote: I've said for a long time, clearly the - a, a critical key to success in the region is going to be Pakistan and our relationship with Pakistan, which was one that was broken in the late '80s and which we've worked hard to restore.
quotes.author: Michael Mullen

quotes.quote: Christmas, my child, is love in action. Every time we love, every time we give, it's Christmas.
quotes.author: Dale Evans

quotes.quote: I want my time to be taken up by chores, errands, appointments, and arguments. In other words, I want to get married.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  I Want

quotes.quote: Putting a little time aside for clean fun and good humor is very necessary to relieve the tensions of our time.
quotes.author: Hattie McDaniel

quotes.quote: I have no time for those who say there is no way Scotland could go it alone. I know first-hand the contribution Scotland and Scots make to Britain's success - so for me there's no question about whether Scotland could be an independent nation.
quotes.author: David Cameron

quotes.quote: If you were to ask me the best time of day to fall in love, I'd say, "Now."But you'd also have to remember to factor in the fact that my watch is eleven minutes fast.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: I mix talents and friendship, which is not very professional, but it's my way of thinking. So I love Azzedine Alaia, because I've known him for 30 years, and he's making my dresses most of the time.
quotes.author: Carine Roitfeld

quotes.quote: You must give everything to make your life as beautiful as the dreams that dance in your imagination.
quotes.author: Roman Payne

quotes.quote: Only time can heal your broken heart. Just as only time can heal his broken arms and legs.
quotes.author: Jim Henson

quotes.quote: Lost Time is never found again.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin,  Poor Richard's Almanack

quotes.quote: There will be time, there will be timeTo prepare a face to meet the faces that you meet.
quotes.author: T.S. Eliot

quotes.quote: At a time when unbridled greed, malignant aggression, and existence of weapons of mass destruction threatens the survival of humanity, we should seriously consider any avenue that offers some hope.
quotes.author: Stanislav Grof

quotes.quote: There is no time for cut-and-dried monotony. There is time for work. And time for love. That leaves no other time.
quotes.author: Coco Chanel

quotes.quote: All love shifts and changes. I don't know if you can be wholeheartedly in love all the time.
quotes.author: Julie Andrews

quotes.quote: The cost of a thing is the amount of what I will call life which is required to be exchanged for it, immediately or in the long run.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau,  Walden

quotes.quote: And therein lies the whole of man's plight. Human time does not turn in a circle; it runs ahead in a straight line. That is why man cannot be happy: happiness is the longing for repetition.
quotes.author: Milan Kundera,  The Unbearable Lightness of Being

quotes.quote: Let the refining and improving of your own life keep you so busy that you have little time to criticize others.
quotes.author: H. Jackson Brown, Jr.

quotes.quote: A great artist is always before his time or behind it.
quotes.author: George Edward Moore

quotes.quote: I'm a big believer in pairing classics with contemporary literature, so students have the opportunity to see that literature is not a cold, dead thing that happened once but instead a vibrant mode of storytelling that's been with us a long time - and will be with us, I hope, for a long time to come.
quotes.author: John Green

quotes.quote: If you have the woman you love, what more do you need? Well, besides an alibi for the time of her husband's murder.
quotes.author: Dark Jar Tin Zoo,  Love Quotes for the Ages. Specifically Ages 19-91.

quotes.author: John Steinbeck

quotes.quote: We may be living past and future lives at the same time we are living this one.
quotes.author: Doug Dillon

quotes.quote: when you live forever and don't age, it gives you time to hope
quotes.author: Laurell K. Hamilton

quotes.quote: There is nothing more powerful than truth. It is undeniable and should always be appreciated. The truth gives you unlimited freedom to be who you are and express how you feel. The truth offers you peace of mind which is something we all love.
quotes.author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana

quotes.quote: When every minute of your day is planned & you are packed for days, you shall soon realize that the pain of past fades, vision of life gets clearer and all that seemed to poison your life Ceases to exist.
quotes.author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

quotes.quote: If you have time to whine then you have time to find solution.
quotes.author: Dee Dee Artner

quotes.quote: If the moment is everthing, then everything is time.
quotes.author: Benny Bellamacina,  The King of Rhyme

quotes.quote: Keep the faith. The vision is always for the appointed time. Be patient, prayerful and wait for the fulfillment of your visions.
quotes.author: Lailah Gifty Akita

quotes.quote: Maybe what River had meant was that time itself was like a river, moving steadily forward, and you got to be in a new river every day, every hour. All my life I'd felt like a lake. A lake where everyhting was contained, forever. All my experiences, all the different people I'd been, everything I'd had, everything I'd lost...I carried them around with me, all the time
quotes.author: Cate Tiernan,  Immortal Beloved

quotes.quote: We are no longer in the dispensation of age and experience. We are in the era of knowledge and information. Information leads a true leader and a true leader leads others.
quotes.author: Israelmore Ayivor

quotes.quote: Your comfort zone is a place where you keep yourself in a self-illusion and nothing can grow there but your potentiality can grow only when you can think and grow out of that zone.
quotes.author: Rashedur Ryan Rahman

quotes.quote: Though why should we expect age to mellow us? If it isn't life's business to reward merit, why should it be life's business to give us warm, comfortable feelings towards its end? What possible evolutionary purpose could nostalgia serve?
quotes.author: Julian Barnes,  The Sense of an Ending

quotes.quote: Get busy with the issue! In this regard, time is not friendly...nor should it be.
quotes.author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

quotes.quote: You got to insist on your success, resist every obstacle and persist in times of difficulty and you will get there.
quotes.author: Israelmore Ayivor,  Shaping the dream

quotes.quote: Don't interpret anything too much. This is time waster number 1.
quotes.author: Dee Dee Artner

quotes.author: Jenny Lewis

quotes.quote: They say beauty is in the eye of the beholder. I think the same could be said for time.
quotes.author: Jake Vander Ark,  The Day I Wore Purple

quotes.quote: I am thankful to all the souls, I meet in the journey of life.
quotes.author: Lailah Gifty Akita,  Think Great: Be Great!

quotes.quote: Time is simply the measurement of human progression against that of existence.
quotes.author: Gerald M. Givens

quotes.quote: Everything in life had a purpose, and unless it achieved that purpose, it was just taking up space on the planet and wasting everybody's time.
quotes.author: Jeannette Walls,  Half Broke Horses

quotes.quote: If you look to lead, invest at least 40% of your time managing yourself - your ethics, character, principles, purpose, motivation, and conduct. Invest at least 30% managing those with authority over you, and 15% managing your peers.
quotes.author: Dee Hock

quotes.quote: Time is standing still; we are moving with the waves of life.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Sometimes you wish the world would be a better place and sometimes you wish the world was a better place. Only the great understanding of the difference of the time between the past and present moment will make it a better place.
quotes.author: Jammy Creamer

quotes.quote: We cannot measure time. We can only measure changes of life and the universe.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Like roses we are born, we grow and expand, in knowledge and bliss, and when our time is due our bodies return to mother Nature.
quotes.author: Joseph Rain

quotes.quote: Time never changes--only we change. We measure the changes of our lives and think that we are measuring time. We are just measuring the movement of the earth.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Simply just BE GRATEFUL what you have today, there is millions who'are crying for the place where you are today
quotes.author: Rashedur Rahman

quotes.quote: Time is standing still, but we are running away from it and complaining that time is slipping away from us.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Create your own path.Don't blindly follow the massess... because most of the time the "M"is silent.
quotes.author: Abhishek Shukla,  The Reflection "Success or Stress"Choose Wisely

quotes.quote: Your friends can be double-edged knife thy can either nurture you or destroy you. Choose them Wisely......
quotes.author: Abhishek Shukla,  The Reflection "Success or Stress"Choose Wisely

quotes.quote: I retired simply because I didn't have the passion and motivation anymore; I was tired. At the time I thought, 'Well, I had a great time, there is the end.' At some moment, there is the right time to call it an end.
quotes.author: Michael Schumacher

quotes.quote: I haven't deliberately set out to play the blonde bombshell in my movies. In fact, it's probably been quite the opposite. After the success of The Mask, I wasn't offered all that many blonde bombshell parts, to be honest. I think people believed from the beginning that I could actually walk and talk at the same time.
quotes.author: Cameron Diaz

quotes.quote: I think that the entertainment industry itself has a history of chasing success. Any time a hit product comes out, all the other companies start chasing after that success and trying to recreate it by putting out similar products.
quotes.author: Shigeru Miyamoto

quotes.quote: Humor is such a wonderful thing, helping you realize what a fool you are but how beautiful that is at the same time.
quotes.author: Lynda Barry

quotes.quote: If I know how you spend your time, then I know what might become of you.
quotes.author: Goethe

quotes.quote: Those who make the worse use of their time are the first to complain of its shortness
quotes.author: Jean de la Bruyere

quotes.quote: There is no greater harm than that of time wasted.
quotes.author: Michelangelo

quotes.quote: Until we can manage time, we can manage nothing else.
quotes.author: Peter Drucker

quotes.quote: No army can withstand the strength of an idea whose time has come.
quotes.author: Victor Hugo
